meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会持续盯着一个 PR:轮询 CI 检查、读新评论和未解决的 review 线程,把真实问题改成分步提交并推送,循环复查,直到检查通过且没有待处理项才停。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、monitor 某个 PR,或持续检查它的评论、review 与 CI 时触发;PR 检查仍在跑、review 线程未解决时也会进入监控。

say.text: 盯着 PR #123,直到检查通过、评论都处理完
say.note: 会轮询检查并读未解决的 review 线程

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR,有新评论就修掉
say.note: 修复后分步提交并推送,再复查

say.text: 这个 PR 还有未解决的 review 线程吗?顺手跑下测试
say.note: 列线程状态、跑相关测试并报告证据

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude keeps watching a pull request: it polls CI checks, reads new comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and repeats until checks pass and nothing actionable remains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to babysit or monitor a PR, or to keep checking its comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until checks pass and comments are resolved
say_en.note: Polls checks and reads unresolved review threads

say_en.text: Babysit this PR and fix any new comments
Any unresolved review threads here? Run tests too
say_en.note: Lists thread state, runs tests, reports evidence
